metaTitle: Custom Set in Sleeve Pullovers | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom set in sleeve pullovers for your team or event. Bulk pricing and fast turnaround at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Set in sleeve pullovers offer a classic, structured fit that stands up to daily wear and repeated washing. Unlike raglan or drop shoulder styles, the set in sleeve construction provides a clean, professional look that works well for corporate uniforms, trade show giveaways, or employee appreciation programs. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing on the front or sleeve for lasting brand visibility.
heroAltText: Custom set in sleeve pullovers with embroidered logo on chest, available in bulk for corporate branding.
